fields.description: This barely-there (7oz) 10L backpack with smart compartments and a bottle holder is your perfect companion for hikes in comfort.
fields.product_name: Quechua NH100 Arpenaz 10 L Hiking Backpack
fields.first_review_content: There are now two Quechua 10L Hiking Backpacks, one for $5.99 and one for $9.99. The appearance and quality and features are much better on this $9.99 one that has an external mesh bottle slot, plus interior zipper slot, plus better straps and rear panel padding. It's the bougie edition. Highly recommended for flights. Note that for occasional use the original lacks features and bougie-appeal, but folds flatter in your carryon.
